description: gate regression: an unexpected SyntaxError on the request path leaves the M27e witness stage undefined; expected: technical failure, exit 2

gate_rules.control: the unpatched tree typechecks, builds, and jest exits 0 (no signal, no timeout) with every test passing; every witness logs exactly its labels' control values and exactly its accepted control errors
gate_rules.technical: the patch applies; the patched tree typechecks and builds; jest exits 0 or 1 without signal or timeout and writes its JSON result; the test inventory (count and every test id) is identical to the control's; no suite execution error
gate_rules.detection: jest exits 1; every named witness fails with WitnessAssertionError; every label logs exactly its manifest mutant value; the failed labels are exactly those whose mutant value differs from the control value; the caught errors are exactly the accepted mutant errors
gate_rules.unexpected: a witness value that is neither the control nor the mutant value, or a caught error the manifest does not accept, is an unexpected failure (technical, exit 2), never check-point evidence

kinds.containment_effect: its effect labels change (runtime state: tool calls, managed state, returned content, cancellation signal)
kinds.both: check and effect labels change in the same run
kinds.component_check_point: the component test's check labels change; never production-path evidence

never_detection: test inventory differs from the control
jest exit status other than 0/1, signal or timeout
witness failure that is not a WitnessAssertionError
witness value matching neither control nor mutant
caught error not accepted by the manifest
